keyFindings: Cushioning is mildly soft with moderate impact protection and a smoother heel transition; the heel feels plush/decently cushioned, but the forefoot firms up and gets less comfortable on longer runs (especially past 8-10 miles).
Responsiveness is a clear weak point: the DNA Loft v3 setup feels non-bouncy and not snappy, and it becomes even less responsive as mileage increases.
Stability is a strength, with prominent medial post + GuideRails support, a very stiff heel counter, and structured midfoot/lateral geometry that provide consistent moderate guidance after break-in.
Durability is average: outsole rubber begins wearing through around 100 miles, exposed midsole can get torn up off-road, and the midsole/forefoot materials compress and firm up over time.
Cushioning is soft and plush with added DNA LOFT v3 (+3 mm forefoot, +1 mm heel), giving solid impact protection and a smooth, balanced heel-to-forefoot transition.
Responsiveness is subdued: energy return is muted with limited bounce/snappiness at faster paces, though rebound is acceptable for easy daily running.
Stability is a major strength, with GuideRails, a secure heel/midfoot hold, and a firmer medial side delivering strong lateral support and predictable control.
Durability is strong, with high-quality upper materials and a redesigned RoadTack outsole showing minimal wear while maintaining reliable traction across road and light gravel surfaces.

Cushioning: Feedback was mixed—one tester found the added DNA Loft v3 stack (37 mm heel / 27 mm forefoot) soft-enough with decent impact protection, while another found it firm/hard and uncomfortable for easy running.
Responsiveness: Limited overall—there was some initial energy return, but the shoe was also described as losing pep after about 5–6 miles and lacking bounce/snappiness.

Stability: Clear strength—GuideRails and raised medial/lateral sidewalls provided strong lateral guidance and pronation control; torsional rigidity and heel-counter stiffness were not explicitly detailed.

Durability: Outsole durability and wet-road grip were rated highly; upper/ankle padding showed quick dirt pickup and some lace-lock changes as cushioning compressed, with no major outsole breakdown noted over ~50 miles.

specsDecision: No automatic score/spec change proposed. Conflicts were recorded for reviewer decision.
